d:
Seth addresses President Trump giving a speech at a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery and more in his monologue for Wednesday, November 11, before taking a closer look at Trump immediately backtracking on his pledge to compromise with Democrats on immigration and claiming the results of the 2026 midterms were somehow fraudulent.
